info.description: This file is a pedagogical stub. It demonstrates the kind of machine-readable door the essay at https://literacy.bayleaf.dev/ discusses: a formal description that a program can use directly, with no LLM needed. There is no server logic behind it. Its one operation fetches a static JSON file. For what the essay is and how agents should help, read https://literacy.bayleaf.dev/llms.txt.

get.description: Returns a fixed JSON file. Nothing is computed, logged or stored by this operation beyond what any static web server does.
